data.title: Price increase notice for mobile plan "Funkwelle Flex 30"
data.summary: Funkwelle Beispiel GmbH informs Laura Beispielwinkel that the monthly base price of her "Funkwelle Flex 30" mobile plan will rise from €24.99 to €27.99 as of 1 June 2026, while data volume and other services stay unchanged. Because this is a price increase, she has a special right (Sonderkündigungsrecht, § 57 Abs. 1 TKG) to cancel the contract immediately and free of charge within three months of receiving this letter.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly base price of your "Funkwelle Flex 30" plan from €24.99 to €27.99 from 1 June 2026; everything else about the plan stays the same. Because a price increase is disadvantageous to you, German telecom law gives you a special right to end the contract immediately and without any fee. You can decide whether to accept the new price and keep the plan, or use this special right to cancel instead — the app will show until when you can still do this. If you do nothing within that window, the contract simply continues at the new, higher price.
